# ARPU and ARPPU per Month

This report shows the average revenue per user and per paying user each month.

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

arpu <- read.csv("ARPUandARPPUperMonth.csv")
arpu$Month <- as.Date(paste0(arpu$Month, "-01"))

arpu_long <- rbind(
  data.frame(Month = arpu$Month, Metric = "ARPU",  Value = arpu$ARPU),
  data.frame(Month = arpu$Month, Metric = "ARPPU", Value = arpu$ARPPU)
)

ggplot(arpu_long, aes(x = Month, y = Value, color = Metric)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  labs(title = "ARPU and ARPPU per Month", x = "Month", y = "Value") +
  theme_minimal()
```
